She then appears lying on a grey padded cot in a room with white walls, eyes closed in a sleeping pose. (2) The camera transitions to a kitchen and living area where another woman in a black hooded robe and gold crown (the Evil Queen) is seen with a small child in a green outfit. (3) A black screen with white text transitions to the child gently touching the sleeping woman's face. A red glass bottle with a white pump and silver cap is shown in detail, held by a small hand. (4) Close-up shots follow, showing a hand dispensing clear liquid from the red bottle and applying it to the sleeping woman's face and neck. The woman then appears awake, posing with her hands to her face to show off glowing, clear skin. (5) She is seen applying a white sheet mask to her face. A split-screen comparison shows 'Day 1' versus 'Day 7' skin texture. Finally, the woman in the Queen costume speaks directly to the camera, and a Watsons brand logo is displayed.

(2) The toddler stands by a sliding glass door in a different pink outfit with a white bow on the back, looking over her shoulder and smiling. (3) A laptop screen displays a scene from a historical Chinese drama alongside images of a pink anime character. (4) A young woman sits at the laptop while the toddler points at the screen showing Sailor Chibi Moon. (5) The woman kneels on the floor, carefully cutting pink fabric with scissors in a domestic setting with storage boxes nearby. (6) Close-ups show the woman using a white sewing machine to stitch pink lace and fabric, then using a small iron to press sharp pleats into pink cloth. (7) Handheld shots capture the process of attaching white felt wings and red ribbons to a costume on a mannequin, and gluing intricate lace to red felt circles. (9) The toddler is shown in full cosplay, including a pink wig, white gloves, and a heart-shaped wand, posing enthusiastically in a bright studio environment. (10) The mother enters the frame dressed as Sailor Moon, and the two pose, hold hands, and dance together joyfully.
